faults.name: Software instability
faults.description: Apps or the operating system crash, freeze, drain power or behave erratically because of software rather than failing hardware.
self_help: Update the operating system and the affected apps.
Restart in Safe Mode to check whether a third-party app is responsible.
Clear the cache/data of the crashing app, or uninstall recently installed apps.
Back up your data, then consider a factory reset as a last resort.

faults.name: Storage nearly full
faults.description: Very little free internal storage, which slows the phone and causes updates and apps to fail.
self_help: Move photos and videos to cloud storage or a computer.
Delete unused apps and large downloads.
Clear app caches from Settings > Storage.

faults.name: Battery wear or battery fault
faults.description: The battery holds less charge than it should, cannot deliver peak power, or reports a fault.
self_help: Check Settings > Battery for apps with unusually high usage.
If the battery or case is swelling, stop using and charging the phone and seek professional help.

faults.name: Charging port or charging circuit issue
faults.description: Power is not reaching the battery reliably through the charging port, cable or charging circuit.
self_help: Try a different cable and charger known to work with another phone.
Inspect the port with a light; remove lint carefully with a wooden or plastic toothpick (power off first).

faults.name: Display or touchscreen damage
faults.description: The screen glass, display panel or touch layer is damaged or faulty.
self_help: Remove any screen protector and case to rule out pressure or a damaged protector.
Restart the phone; if touch problems disappear after a restart, the cause may be software.

faults.name: Camera issue
faults.description: A camera module, lens or the camera software is not working correctly.
self_help: Clean the lens with a microfibre cloth.
Clear the Camera app's cache and data, and test a third-party camera app.

faults.name: Speaker or microphone issue
faults.description: The loudspeaker, earpiece or microphone is blocked, damaged or not working.
self_help: Gently clean speaker and microphone openings with a soft dry brush.
Disconnect Bluetooth devices, which can silently take over audio.

faults.name: Cellular or Wi-Fi connectivity issue
faults.description: The phone has trouble with mobile signal, the SIM, mobile data or Wi-Fi.
self_help: Toggle Airplane mode off and on, and restart the phone.
Re-seat the SIM card, or test with another SIM.
Reset network settings (this forgets saved Wi-Fi networks).

faults.name: Possible liquid damage
faults.description: Exposure to water or other liquids may have caused corrosion or short circuits; effects can appear days later.
self_help: If exposure was recent: power the phone off, do not charge it, and let it dry. Do not use heat or rice as a cure.
Have it inspected promptly; corrosion gets worse over time.
